objective: Independently recompute every structural selection and all 14,654,784 fp16 deployed scalars from the pinned source shards, then strict-load the artifact into the independently certified LayerCake v7 host and compare CPU/CUDA finite argmax behavior.

checks.selection_recomputation: independent stable fp64 GPU energy rankings for residual coordinates, complete attention heads, and SwiGLU neurons
checks.tensor_recomputation: exact equality of every fp16 scalar after independently applying frozen mappings and scales
checks.key_set: exact LayerCake v7 state_dict key set
checks.accounting: parameters, payload, zero logits, zero activations, zero teacher forwards, zero complete source blocks, and artifact hash
checks.host_conformance: strict state_dict load, exact parameter count, finite CPU/CUDA logits, equal CPU/CUDA argmax

decision_rule: Pass only if every selected index, tensor key, and all 14,654,784 fp16 scalars independently match; accounting is exact; the artifact strict-loads into the bound LayerCake v7 class; and CPU/CUDA logits are finite with identical argmax. A pass authorizes one separately preregistered structural-initialized acquisition candidate, not a quality claim.
claim_boundary: Hostile structural extraction and host-conformance verification only; no English quality, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
